{{Top|leg}}
'''Jeron''' was a manufacturing company. They made anything from [[Fusioncutter/Legends|Fusion Cutters]] to [[Hydrospanner/Legends|hydrospanners]].

==Behind the scenes==
The company ''Jeron'' was invented by [[Justin Chin]] to explain the weapon's name in the ''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]'' game. As he said, the name just popped up suddenly in his head without any meaning or significance, when it was needed to find one and print the manual.
